Library Management & Data Quality Implement and maintain centralized component libraries including symbol, footprint, part, and component data management. Strong understanding of electronics product development processes and the PCB design lifecycle. Proven experience with Siemens EDA solutions including Xpedition Enterprise, EDM Design, and EDM Library. Hands-on knowledge of PCB tools including schematic capture, PCB layout, design reuse, constraint management, and design release processes.
